name: Fleet Management
description: At-a-glance view of Bitcoin miners on the local network
config_help:
Bind one *Username & password* account to each miner family you run. The widget logs into every miner of a family with that one account, so they must all share the same username and password. A family left unbound is listed but not read. AxeOS miners need no account.

The miner APIs are plain HTTP, so the password crosses your local network unencrypted. To keep the account from being sent anywhere else, list your network's range, for example `192.168.1.0/24`, under the account's allowed destinations.

A BOS password containing `"` or `\` cannot be used.

fleet_name.name: Fleet name
fleet_name.description: Heading shown above the fleet overview

axeos_enabled.name: Show AxeOS miners
axeos_enabled.description: Include AxeOS miners in the fleet view and keep polling them

chart_span_minutes.name: Chart time range
chart_span_minutes.description: Time range covered by the hashrate charts. A fixed number of points spans the range, so a longer range samples less often.

bos.label: BOS miners
bos.description: The login of every BOS miner on the network. The username is root.

ubos.label: Braiins OS Libre devices
ubos.description: The HTTP Basic login of every Braiins OS Libre device on the network.
